held.name: Artificial Analysis Decision Index reference
held.reason: Methodology reference requested by owner; no numbers imported. Existing source policy excludes its restricted data. Its fixed mix of evaluations differs from our multi-evaluator fit, so more evidence does not imply convergence to the same model order.

conclusion: One additional inference evaluator, not five independent studies. This improves evidence for five existing models but does not add a second admitted evaluator for Jeffan or resolve breadth of the leaders. No scoring weights tuned to reproduce another leaderboard.
